text_blocks.snippet: Chris Cuomo was fired from CNN in December 2021 due to his involvement in helping his brother, former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, with his legal defense against sexual harassment allegations. Following his termination, Cuomo launched a $125 million arbitration lawsuit against CNN. He now hosts a show on NewsNation called "Cuomo".

list.title: CNN Firing:
list.snippet: In December 2021, CNN terminated Chris Cuomo's employment after it was revealed that he used his journalistic position to help his brother, then-Governor Andrew Cuomo, respond to sexual harassment allegations.

list.title: Arbitration Lawsuit:
list.snippet: Cuomo subsequently filed a $125 million arbitration lawsuit against CNN, alleging wrongful termination and claiming that the network breached its contract with him.

list.title: NewsNation:
list.snippet: Cuomo joined NewsNation in 2022 and currently hosts a primetime program called "Cuomo".

list.title: Sexual Misconduct Allegation:
list.snippet: Prior to his termination, Cuomo faced a sexual misconduct allegation from a former colleague.

list.title: Disputes with CNN:
list.snippet: On his podcast, Cuomo expressed his desire to settle the lawsuit with CNN and stated that he did not lie to the network about his actions. He also mentioned that his actions were known by his CNN boss at the time, contradicting the network's stance.
